## Repository contract

- [ ] Every commit has the author's `Signed-off-by:` DCO trailer.
- [ ] Material AI assistance is disclosed with `Assisted-by:` trailers.
- [ ] Financial fixtures are synthetic or deliberately sanitized.
- [ ] Every document above has a disposition, and each updated document is accurate
      for this change.
- [ ] The application version is advanced for code/runtime behavior changes, or this
      pull request explains why no version change is required.
